patch_description:
Replace the three-hop approximation, which reduced both scoring components, with a bounded transit-competition discount on existing two-hop rewards.

Split each OD pair’s demand among its retained routes in proportion to their reward magnitudes, then accumulate the offered transit load at each intermediate node. Reduce rewards through above-average-load intermediates by at most 20%. This addresses competition created by the selected routes themselves, beyond the existing endpoint-demand pressure estimate. Normalizing by mean transit load keeps the correction size-independent. No new couplings or degree penalties are introduced, and the structural penalties remain unchanged.
